attributes.title: Level 3

subgroups.name: Discover

steps.text: Watch this video to learn about using events in your projects to let the user trigger things to happen.

questions.hint: What would happen when an event occurs in a computer program?
questions.title: [Select one] In a computer program, an event is __________.

answers.text: A celebration held by the sprites in a project.
A special occasion where sequence does not matter.
An action that triggers code to run.
A chunk of code that runs randomly.

questions.correctResponse: Remember an event is like a line of dominoes!

questions.hint: Which things might trigger code to run in a project?
questions.title: [Select one] Which of the following is an example of an event in code?

answers.text: The user presses the arrow keys to move a sprite.
The user presses play ▶ to start the project.
The user presses A to close a dialog box.

questions.correctResponse: An event triggers code to run with  user input, such as pressing a button.

questions.hint: Which option(s) might trigger something to happen in real life?
questions.title: [Select one] Which of the following are examples of events outside of code?

answers.text: Pressing a button on a microwave
Blowing the whistle at the start of a soccer match

questions.correctResponse: Does the action trigger something to happen?

questions.hint: What action will trigger the move with buttons code block to run?
questions.title: [Select one] If the user does not press the arrow keys, the move with buttons code block will not run.
questions.correctResponse: For events, the action needs to happen first  to trigger the code to run.

subgroups.title: Events!
subgroups.introduction: Watch this video to learn about using events in your projects to let the user trigger things to happen.

attributes.description: You’ve reached Level 3 of White Belt! In this level, you’ll learn about events, which are actions that trigger code in your project to run. Here are the achievements you’ll unlock in Level 3:

badges.title: An Event to Remember
badges.description: Use events to control actions in a project.

badges.title: Taking Control
badges.description: Use the direction buttons to move a sprite.

badges.title: Think Inside the Box
badges.description: Set a sprite to stay inside the screen.

badges.title: Setting the Scene
badges.description: Add a background image to a project.

badges.title: Layer Cake
badges.description: Use sequence to control which sprite is in front of another.
